solo.name: enough stock succeeds
solo.trace:
solo check: enough stock succeeds
call: purchase(db, product_id=1, qty=3)
schedule choices: []
step 1   R1  BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED -> BEGIN
step 2   R1  WITH upd AS ( UPDATE products SET stock = stock - 3 WHERE id = 1 AND stock >= 3 RETURNING id ) INSERT INTO orders (product_id, qty) SELECT id, 3 FROM upd RETURNING id -> INSERT 0 1 [(1,)]
step 3   R1  COMMIT -> COMMIT
         R1  returned True
invariant ok: stock never negative
invariant ok: expected state: SELECT p.stock = 2 AND o.n = 1 AND o.total = 3 FROM products p, (SELECT count(*) AS n, sum(qty) AS total FROM orders WHERE product_id = 1) o WHERE p.id = 1
